summary: On Windows, install WSL2 (wsl --install --no-distribution), force cgroup v2 in wsl.conf, install Podman Desktop, check podman info, and add a docker.bat wrapper calling podman to your PATH for Dev Containers.
questions: How do I install Ansible development tools on Windows?
How do I use Podman instead of Docker with VS Code Dev Containers on Windows?
Enable cgroup v2 in WSL2 for Podman

answer_card.title: ansible-dev-tools on Windows
answer_card.answer_md:
```
wsl --install --no-distribution
```

`%USERPROFILE%/wsl.conf`:

```
[wsl2]
kernelCommandLine = cgroup_no_v1="all"
```

Install Podman Desktop, check `podman info | findstr cgroup`, then create `%USERPROFILE%\bin\docker.bat`:

```
@echo off
podman %*
```

and add `%USERPROFILE%\bin` to your user PATH.
